stem.text: Which compound is chiral and reacts with $\text{Na}_2\text{CO}_3$ to give $\text{CO}_2$?

A.alt: Skeletal/displayed formula of a C=C double bond with H and CO2H on each carbon, drawn in cis geometry (H groups on the same side).

B.alt: Skeletal formula: cyclohexene ring with a CH3 group and an OH group on the same carbon, which is a ring carbon next to the C=C.

C.alt: Displayed structural formula: HCO2–CH(CH2Br)–CH3, with the CH2Br group drawn above and the CH3 group drawn below the central carbon.

D.alt: Displayed structural formula: CH3CH2CHBrCO2H drawn as a vertical chain, with CHBrCO2H at the top and CH2 and CH3 below.
